Supports, Project Management, Supply Chain Management in supplier negotiations, claims and project changes. Manages the petty cash and has delegated authority for local purchasing within agreed limits. Ensures all documentation is modified and updated as necessary, the document handling system is maintained, and latest revisions are used for the construction work on site. Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Bachelors/ Masters, exposure to PMP and Management studies are added advantages. Minimum relevant Experience of 8-12 years in relevant. Specific skills required Exposure to Telecom, SCADA, RTU, contract management, Negotiation skills with contractors, should be Arabic Expert, Willing to travel.
